summary: Regression + refactor validation of Lechrol WZ SPA passed 100%. Verified: app loads, sidebar nav, '+ Nowa WZ' opens editor with today's date and default place 'Łomianki', live number preview updates as contractor name is typed ('Rolety Siejka' -> 8001/RA/2026). ItemsEditor refactor: Enter in last row adds a new row AND focuses its item-name input; 'Dodaj pozycję' works; X removes row (min 1 stays). CRITICAL stable-rowId check: filled 3 rows (Deska A/B/C), removed the FIRST row — remaining 2 rows kept correct values (Deska B/2 and Deska C/3), confirming stable keys. Save validation toast 'Podaj nazwę odbiorcy.', success toast 'Zapisano dokument .', title flips to 'Edycja WZ ', Usuń button appears; editing the doc keeps the same number. PreviewModal opens on eye icon, contains number/contractor/items; Escape and X close it; Drukuj triggers window.print (stubbed, counter incremented). DOMPurify XSS test with contractor name 'Test' and item 'Deska' — window.__xss stayed undefined, no live
critical_code_review_comments: Defense-in-depth is good: buildPrintHtml escapes via esc() first and then sanitizedPrintHtml pipes through DOMPurify. Even if esc() were removed accidentally, DOMPurify would still strip <script> and event handler attributes.
ItemsEditor uses rowId (uid()) as React key — stable across re-renders and confirmed by the 3-row remove-first test. Good refactor.
useConfirm hook: closeConfirm resolves the promise via the setter callback — safely handles double-close race conditions.
PreviewModal memoizes sanitized HTML via useMemo keyed on [doc, settings] — avoids re-sanitizing on every render.
Minor: emailConfirm callback in App.tsx is defined but only used inside the desktop path; in browser mode emailDocument returns before calling it. Fine as-is.
Minor: EditorView collectItems keeps rows with only qty (no name) — unchanged from prior iteration; product decision.
seed_data_creation: One WZ doc with intentional XSS payload contractor name/item created during test (in localStorage 'lechrol-wz-data' of preview session). Not persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor regression verified. All new data-testids for ConfirmDialog (confirm-overlay/confirm-message/confirm-accept-btn/confirm-cancel-btn) and PreviewModal (preview-overlay/preview-page/preview-title/preview-print-btn/preview-pdf-btn/preview-close-btn) present and functional. Note: when writing an XSS-detection test, don't rely on overriding window.alert to detect XSS — instead check for absence of live <script> / <img[onerror]> nodes in the sanitized DOM and confirm window.__xss stays undefined. Stub window.print via page.add_init_script to avoid the print dialog blocking preview button tests.
